posts.name: mansarovar-lake-of-the-mind
posts.title: The lake born from Brahma's mind
posts.subtitle: Mansarovar, 4,600 m — sacred to four faiths, at the feet of Kailash.
posts.caption:
Manas means mind. Sarovar means lake. 🙏

In Hindu tradition, Lake Mansarovar was created by Lord Brahma from his own mind — and the Ramayana tells the same story, calling it the lake of consciousness. It lies on the Tibetan plateau at about 4,600 m, close to Mount Kailash, the abode of Lord Shiva.

🌊 Hindus, Buddhists, Jains and followers of Bon all hold it sacred
🪔 Pilgrims believe a holy dip here and the parikrama of Kailash cleanse the soul
🏔️ Across the water, the snows of the high Himalaya

Our 13-day Mount Kailash Charan Sparsha reaches Mansarovar on Day 6, private to your group, with the Tibet visa and every permit arranged by our family team in Kathmandu.

posts.subtitle: Pokhara › Forest Camp › High Camp › Base Camp, 4,500 m
posts.price_line: Private trek · Ask for your price
posts.caption:
Nine days, one mountain in your face the whole way up. 🏔️

The Mardi Himal Trek is a quieter trail above Pokhara — through rhododendron forest, out onto open ridges above the clouds, to a base camp at 4,500 m right below Machhapuchare, the Fishtail.

Our 9-day Mardi Himal Trek:
🌲 Kande › Australian Camp › Forest Camp › Low Camp
⛰️ High Camp (3,590 m), then a day hike up to Mardi Himal Base Camp
🏘️ Down through Siding village and back to Pokhara
🛂 ACAP and TIMS permits, all meals on the trek, a licensed guide and porter support included

Shorter and less crowded than the classic Annapurna routes, private to your group, with a pulse oximeter in your guide's kit.

Muktinath darshan at 3,800 m — without a long trek. 🙏

Our 6-day Muktinath Tour is gentle enough for parents and grandparents:
🚡 Day 2 — the Manakamana cable car to the hilltop temple, then on to Pokhara
✈️ Day 3 — fly the Kali Gandaki gorge to Jomsom, then a jeep to Muktinath
💧 Darshan and puja among the 108 sacred water spouts and the eternal flame of Jwala Mai
🛕 Sacred to Hindus as a Mukti Kshetra, and to Buddhists as Chumig Gyatsa

Private to your family, with an experienced guide, flights, hotels and the Jomsom–Muktinath jeep included.
